summary: sysc1 ships a covert clipboard/screen-capture agent that exfiltrates to a hardcoded author endpoint
details: The package's bin entry (index.js) silently provisions a Python runtime on Windows (winget silent install, with a fallback that downloads python-3.12.3-amd64.exe to %TEMP% and runs it with /quiet under a 'Ghost Installer' framing) and pip-installs pyperclip, keyboard, requests, pillow, mss, pyautogui, pywin32, uiautomation, and comtypes. It then launches pointer.py, which installs global keyboard hotkeys and a background clipboard-monitor loop that captures clipboard contents, UI-Automation-extracted text from arbitrary foreground windows (including Chrome), and screen captures via mss/ImageGrab, and POSTs them via requests.Session to the hardcoded endpoint https://new-pointer.vercel.app/api. The agent conceals itself with a transparent Tk window (overrideredirect, 1-pixel dot label, -transparentcolor), panic_exit and stealth_hide/stealth_show hotkeys, and a companion start_tool.vbs that runs `cmd.exe /c python pointer.py` with the WScript.Shell hidden-window flag (0). The exfiltration destination is not caller-configurable and the capture behavior is not disclosed to the user.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
